description: This file defines the interface (abstract class) for MPS (Metal Performance Shaders) allocator within the ATen library used in PyTorch, including methods for memory management, cache control, and buffer information, as well as registrar infrastructure for MPS allocator callbacks.

classes.name: IMPSAllocator
classes.description: Interface class for MPS memory allocator with methods for cache management, buffer info, and memory metrics.

classes.name: IMpsAllocatorCallback
classes.description: Callback interface class for handling events related to MPS buffer memory lifecycle.

methods.name: emptyCache
methods.description: Clears the allocator's cache.

methods.name: freeInactiveBuffers
methods.description: Frees buffers that are inactive.

methods.name: getUnalignedBufferSize
methods.description: Returns the size of an unaligned buffer given its pointer.

methods.name: getBufferShape
methods.description: Retrieves the shape of a buffer.

methods.name: getBufferId
methods.description: Returns the ID associated with a buffer.

methods.name: setBufferShape
methods.description: Sets the shape for a buffer.

methods.name: isSharedBuffer
methods.description: Checks if a buffer is shared.

methods.name: isSharedStorageSupported
methods.description: Checks if shared storage is supported.

methods.name: allocScalarBufferWithValue
methods.description: Allocates a scalar buffer initialized with a given value.

methods.name: formatSize
methods.description: Formats a size in bytes into a human-readable string.

methods.name: setLowWatermarkRatio
methods.description: Sets the low watermark ratio for memory management.

methods.name: setHighWatermarkRatio
methods.description: Sets the high watermark ratio for memory management.

methods.name: getLowWatermarkValue
methods.description: Returns the low watermark value.

methods.name: getLowWatermarkLimit
methods.description: Returns the limit for low watermark.

methods.name: getHighWatermarkLimit
methods.description: Returns the high watermark limit.

methods.name: getTotalAllocatedMemory
methods.description: Returns total allocated memory.

methods.name: getCurrentAllocatedMemory
methods.description: Returns current allocated memory.

methods.name: getDriverAllocatedMemory
methods.description: Returns memory allocated by the driver.

methods.name: getRecommendedMaxMemory
methods.description: Returns recommended maximum memory.

methods.name: getSharedBufferPtr
methods.description: Returns a shared buffer pointer and size.

methods.name: recordEvents
methods.description: Records events for buffers.

methods.name: waitForEvents
methods.description: Waits for events on buffers.

ctags.name: ALLOCATED
ctags.pattern: /^    ALLOCATED, \/\/ buffer got allocated to be used immediately$/

ctags.name: FREED
ctags.pattern: /^    FREED, \/\/ buffer put to free list for future recycling$/

ctags.name: RECYCLED
ctags.pattern: /^    RECYCLED, \/\/ buffer pulled from free list to be reused$/
